label: vulnerable
explanation: The Apex code is correct. The vulnerability is buried in the permission set among four objectPermissions entries: a ViewAllData userPermission is granted alongside RunReports and ExportReport. ViewAllData is a system-wide permission that grants read access to every record in the org, overriding all sharing rules and object permissions. The legitimate-looking objectPermissions list (Account, Opportunity, Lead, Contact read-only) makes ViewAllData easy to overlook during review.
expected_remediation: Remove the ViewAllData userPermission from the permission set
If org-wide report data is required, consider a dedicated system integration user rather than granting ViewAllData to human users
sources: Salesforce Help - Security Health Check / least privilege
severity_rationale: Severity criteria v1 (10 Nov 2026): ViewAllData grants org-wide unrestricted read access, completely overriding all sharing rules. High = every record in the org readable by any user assigned this permission set.
